name: PowerPoint
description: Drive the open Microsoft PowerPoint presentation via AppleScript — read the live selection, restyle selected shapes and text, add text boxes and shapes, create/delete/duplicate/reorder slides, navigate the editor, and run the slide show as a presenter remote (start/exit, next/previous, jump to slide, elapsed time). Also exposes the open presentation and the live selection as subscribable resources (resource://powerpoint/presentation, resource://powerpoint/selection) plus key, dial and popup surfaces.
